objective: Provide pucca house with basic amenities to eligible houseless rural households.
description: Implemented from 1 April 2016. Framework 2022 applicable. Minimum house size: 25 sq metres including cooking area. Unit assistance: Rs 1.20 lakh (plain areas), Rs 1.30 lakh (hilly/NE/difficult). Cost sharing: 60:40 (Centre:State) for plains; 90:10 for NE/Himachal/Uttarakhand/J&K; 100% Central for UTs. Toilet assistance Rs 12,000 via SBM-G/MGNREGS convergence. MGNREGS labour: 90/95 person-days. Beneficiary selection via SECC 2011 housing deprivation data and Awaas+ lists verified by Gram Sabha. AwaasApp for geo-tagged monitoring. Institutional finance up to Rs 70,000 facilitated. Extended 2024-29 with 2 crore additional houses; total target 4.95 crore by 2029.
implementing_agency: State/UT Governments, District Administration, Gram Panchayats
